name: Nick Jr. Replay!
summary:
Step into a world of wonder with Nick Jr. Replay! Let your preschooler's imagination run wild and revisit tons of beloved retro Nick Jr. games, authentically preserved, in a vibrant, interactive universe where learning and laughter go hand in hand!

Nick Jr. Replay! is a joyful adventure packed with games, creativity, and beloved characters that make every moment magical. This safe and engaging playground helps kids build essential skills in math, reading, art, and problem-solving — all while having a blast!
